σκοπός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for צָפָה ;]
__1. a watcher, watchman (Eze.3:17, al.).
__2. a mark on which to fix the eye (Wis.5:12, 21, al.). Metaphorical, of an aim or object: Php.3:14.†

strongs.def: perhaps akin to G4626 (σκάπτω) through the idea of concealment; compare G4629 (σκέπασμα)); a watch (sentry or scout), i.e. (by implication) a goal
